title: FDA drops warning letter on Bausch & Lomb, citing contamination concerns
llm_note: The FDA issued a warning letter to Bausch & Lomb regarding contamination concerns at its Tampa, Florida, manufacturing facility.

title: Cellares and Ori Biotech’s new cell therapy manufacturing contracts
llm_note: Cellares entered a partnership to provide manufacturing services for GenomeFrontier Therapeutics' CAR-T therapy.

title: Sartorius and NIBRT Partner on Intensified and Continuous Bioprocessing Training Center
llm_note: Sartorius and NIBRT are establishing a training center for continuous bioprocessing in Dublin.

title: Vaxthera to license Codagenix’s Syn17D-YF yellow fever vaccine
llm_note: Vaxthera and Codagenix partnered to license a synthetic vaccine candidate specifically designed for cell-culture manufacturing.

title: NIH grant supports Inomagen’s gene therapy for atrial fibrillation
llm_note: The NIH grant explicitly supports manufacturing activities for an investigational plasmid-based gene therapy.
